thread:
elaine: Quick q — candidate OFR-2026-045 (Arjun Kumar). International hire; consulate delay. Recruiter suggests pushing start ~6 weeks and doing a split sign-on (bridge now, remainder at actual start). Do we need a comp-band exception or is this covered by existing sign-on policy?

ana_r: Candidate verbally accepted. Manager asked us to hold them. Proposed: total sign-on $10,000, split 5k now / 5k at start. Base unchanged. Also want to pro-rate first partial month.

mike_g: Manager here. I approve the split in principle — would rather secure them. If this exceeds sign-on cap for the band, route to comp committee.

rodger_fin: Need numbers and band info. Also payroll/tax implications for a cross-border bridging payment. What's the band and current sign-on cap?

ana_r: Offer details: BASE $165,000, Band L3-B (band max ~$170k). Proposed sign-on total = $10,000. Company's standard sign-on cap for L3-B is $8,000 (exceptions require committee). Candidate currently outside US; visa = H-1B consular processing.

rodger_fin: 10k > 8k cap — this is an exception. Please route to comp-committee. Also provide candidate country and visa status for payroll.

visa-bot: visa-status OFR-2026-045: H1B-consular; docs received 2026-03-10; est clearance 4–8 weeks.

ana_r: Candidate located in Bangalore, India. Estimated start (if approved) 2026-05-01.

elaine: Thanks. Rodger, can you open the exception request? I'll prep the docs for committee.

rodger_fin: Will do. Please include the following in the request: OFFER_ID, candidate name, band, proposed sign-on amount and split, reason (visa delay), manager approval, and payroll notes. Use this template in the form: 

```
OFFER_ID: OFR-2026-045
CANDIDATE: Arjun Kumar
BAND: L3-B
CURRENT_BASE: 165000
REQ_SIGNON: 10000
PROPOSED_SPLIT: 5000 now / 5000 at start
REASON: Visa consular delay — bridge payment to secure acceptance
REQUESTED_BY: ana_r
MANAGER_SIGNOFF: pending (mike_g)
PAYROLL_NOTE: candidate outside US; bridge payment taxed under India payroll rules until US start
```

rodger_fin: I'll slot it for the comp-committee meeting today at 15:00 PT. If committee needs more info, tag @finance and @legal.

mike_g: /approve-offer OFR-2026-045 — manager sign-off from my side. :thumbsup:

ana_r: I'll update the candidate with a conditional note: bridge payment is subject to paperwork and will be issued as a contractor/staffing payment if necessary and reconciled when onboarded. Also will attach clause in revised offer letter.

elaine: Please loop legal on the clause wording. Also thread the payroll team so GL codes are ready.

rodger_fin: Noted. If committee denies, fallback options: cap sign-on at $8k or offer additional equity refresh instead. I'll mark urgency.

offer-bot: Offer revision submitted for OFR-2026-045 — link: https://redwood.example/offers/OFR-2026-045/revision (private).

elaine: Appreciate it. We'll reconvene after the committee decision.

ana_r: Thanks everyone — I'll keep candidate updated as conditional. :pray:
